_comment: From PRD section 8, Dataset D (tiswan14/acne-dataset-image, ~4,620 images, Apache 2.0 per its description - classification-oriented, NOT bounding boxes, despite covering the same lesion types as the Dataset C detector). Papules/Pustules/Cysts don't have their own classifier concern label, so they're folded into 'acne'. Verify real folder names after download before trusting this.
